at most one pending and one active epoch

without the send-time roster check, a removed member keeps reading

without the 10-minute passkey window a stale cookie plus a recovery code is enough

one clearing request per account, across all workspaces

service_checks.title: The real hierarchy guard rejects loss for a superior and accepts loss for a lower member
Removing a superior from an existing private channel is refused
Changing privacy preserves the owner and superior access claimed by H2/H3
service_checks.detail: Lower manager made a public channel private; both owner and superior lost visibility. M2 has no privacy-change transition.

service_checks.title: Moving categories preserves superior access claimed by H2
service_checks.detail: Lower manager moved a channel to a category denying the superior VIEW_CHANNELS. M2 has no category-move transition.

service_checks.title: A non-manager without the active key must use the fresh-start path, as M3 and canRotate require
service_checks.detail:
canRotate=false, but POST /mls/epochs returned 201 for a non-holder/non-manager without fresh-start proof or manager notification

201 !== 403

service_checks.title: A sequential unchanged save does not permit a clearing request
An in-flight unchanged save cannot bypass the change-after-warning requirement A3
service_checks.detail: Missing expected rejection: The second save wrote identical content after the warning and incorrectly advanced profileUpdatedAt

service_checks.title: Concurrent requests in two workspaces still consume only one account allowance
Equal decoded pixels give equal sanitized bytes, as the sanitizer contract claims

service_checks.detail: Missing expected rejection: Changing only the PNG row filter counted as changing the picture after the warning
